array.string: echo 'SBDISP start' >/dev/console; sleep 40; (/usr/sbin/system_profiler SPDisplaysDataType 2>&1 | /usr/bin/head -60 >/dev/console; echo 'SBDISP profiler done' >/dev/console) & sleep 50; (/usr/bin/log show --last 5m --style compact --predicate 'process == "WindowServer" AND eventMessage CONTAINS "Display:"' 2>&1 | /usr/bin/tail -150 >/dev/console; echo 'SBDISP log done' >/dev/console) & sleep 50; echo 'SBDISP open System Settings' >/dev/console; /usr/bin/open -a 'System Settings' 2>/dev/console; echo 'SBDISP done' >/dev/console
